newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends three cents up on London.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends three cents up on London.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed three cents higher at 14.21 ringgit ($5.67) a kg as the market took its cue from a firmer London close yesterday.
Traders said there were more demand from Europe, Japan and Malaysia and turnover rose to 104 tonnes from 80 on Tuesday.
Support was also seen after the local premium over London market narrowed down to $90 a tonne from $110 on Tuesday.
The market is likely to trade around current levels, traders said, expecting more demand from overseas if London prices continue to rise.
